boosts.title: VOID Boost Perks
boosts.description: Boost our server to unlock exclusive perks and rewards! Your support helps the VOID community grow.
items: 💎 1 BOOST: Extra Entries in giveaways; Bypass Slowmode in chat channels; Ability to change your nickname
🔥 2 BOOSTS: 1 Custom Emoji; Custom Role (custom color & emoji next to name); 1 Custom Sticker
⚠️ Perks will be lost if you leave or unboost the server (added emoji/sticker will stay).
🎟️ HOW TO CLAIM: Open a ticket in #tickets to claim your perks!
